description: Positional analysis: where along the DMD coding sequence are truncating variants tolerated in hemizygous males?
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, json, requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

D=pd.read_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_variants_flat.csv")
PLOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant"}
hc=D[(D.csq.isin(PLOF))&(D.lof=="HC")].copy()

def cpos(h):
    if not isinstance(h,str): return np.nan
    m=re.search(r'c\.(-?\d+)', h)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else np.nan
hc["cdna"]=hc.hgvsc.map(cpos)
hc=hc[hc.cdna.notna() & (hc.cdna>0)]
CDS=11058.0
hc["frac"]=hc.cdna/CDS
hc["tolerated"]=hc.hemi>0

# exon map from Ensembl canonical transcript (minus strand), for exon-rank assignment
tx=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/ENST00000357033?expand=1;content-type=application/json",timeout=120).json()
tr=tx["Translation"]
ex=sorted(tx["Exon"], key=lambda e:e["start"], reverse=(tx["strand"]==-1))
cum=0; rows=[]
for i,e in enumerate(ex,1):
    ov=max(0, min(e["end"],tr["end"])-max(e["start"],tr["start"])+1)
    rows.append(dict(rank=i, coding=ov, cds_start=cum+1 if ov else np.nan, cds_end=cum+ov if ov else np.nan))
    cum+=ov
EX=pd.DataFrame(rows)
def exon_of(c):
    m=EX[(EX.cds_start<=c)&(EX.cds_end>=c)]
    return int(m.iloc[0]["rank"]) if len(m) else np.nan
hc["exon"]=hc.cdna.map(exon_of)

tol=hc[hc.tolerated]; dep=hc[~hc.tolerated]
print("HC-pLoF with parsable CDS position: %d (tolerated in >=1 hemizygous male: %d; absent from males: %d)"%(len(hc),len(tol),len(dep)))
print("\nCDS fractional position, median [IQR]:")
print("  tolerated : %.3f [%.3f-%.3f]"%(tol.frac.median(),tol.frac.quantile(.25),tol.frac.quantile(.75)))
print("  depleted  : %.3f [%.3f-%.3f]"%(dep.frac.median(),dep.frac.quantile(.25),dep.frac.quantile(.75)))

# distance to nearest end of the CDS (0 = at a terminus, 0.5 = dead centre)
hc["edge"]=np.minimum(hc.frac, 1-hc.frac)
U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(hc.loc[hc.tolerated,"edge"], hc.loc[~hc.tolerated,"edge"])
n1,n2=len(tol),len(dep); r_rb=1-2*U/(n1*n2)
print("\nDistance to nearest CDS terminus (0=terminus, 0.5=middle):")
print("  tolerated median %.3f ; depleted median %.3f"%(tol.frac.map(lambda f:min(f,1-f)).median(), dep.frac.map(lambda f:min(f,1-f)).median()))
print("  Mann-Whitney U=%.0f p=%.3g  rank-biserial r=%.3f"%(U,p,r_rb))

# terminal 10% of CDS vs central 80%
hc["terminal10"]=hc.edge<0.10
a=int((hc.tolerated&hc.terminal10).sum()); b=int((hc.tolerated&~hc.terminal10).sum())
c=int(((~hc.tolerated)&hc.terminal10).sum()); d=int(((~hc.tolerated)&~hc.terminal10).sum())
OR,pf=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
se=np.sqrt(sum(1/max(x,.5) for x in (a,b,c,d)))
print("\nTolerated pLoF in the terminal 10%% of the CDS vs central 80%%: [[%d,%d],[%d,%d]] OR=%.3g 95%%CI %.3g-%.3g p=%.3g"
      %(a,b,c,d,OR,OR*np.exp(-1.96*se),OR*np.exp(1.96*se),pf))

print("\nHemizygote-tolerated HC-pLoF with >=2 hemizygotes, annotated by exon:")
t2=tol[tol.hemi>=2].sort_values("hemi",ascending=False)
print(t2[["variant_id","hgvsc","csq","exon","cdna","ac","hemi"]].to_string(index=False))
hc.to_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_HCpLoF_positional.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5.0))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(dep.frac, np.random.RandomState(1).normal(0,.06,len(dep)), s=16, color="#AAAAAA", alpha=.7, label=f"absent from hemizygous males (n={len(dep)})")
ax.scatter(tol.frac, np.random.RandomState(2).normal(1,.06,len(tol)), s=22+6*np.log1p(tol.hemi), color="#C44E52", edgecolor="k", lw=.3, label=f"present in hemizygous males (n={len(tol)})")
for _,r in t2.head(6).iterrows():
    ax.annotate(f"{r.hgvsc.split(':')[-1]}\n{int(r.hemi)} hemi", (r.frac,1), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,14), ha="center", fontsize=7)
ax.axvspan(0,0.10,color="#4C72B0",alpha=.10); ax.axvspan(0.90,1.0,color="#4C72B0",alpha=.10)
ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["depleted","tolerated"]); ax.set_ylim(-.5,1.8)
ax.set_xlabel("position along DMD coding sequence (fraction of 11,058 bp)")
ax.set_title("Where truncating DMD variants are tolerated in males\ngnomAD v4.1.0, LOFTEE high-confidence pLoF; shaded = terminal 10%", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc="upper center")

ax=axes[1]
cats=["synonymous","missense","HC pLoF\n(all)","HC pLoF\ncentral 80%"]
dd=pd.read_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_variants_flat.csv")
vals=[(dd[dd.csq=="synonymous_variant"].hemi>0).mean()*100,
      (dd[dd.csq=="missense_variant"].hemi>0).mean()*100,
      hc.tolerated.mean()*100,
      hc[~hc.terminal10].tolerated.mean()*100]
ns=[int((dd.csq=="synonymous_variant").sum()), int((dd.csq=="missense_variant").sum()), len(hc), int((~hc.terminal10).sum())]
bars=ax.bar(cats, vals, color=["#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#C44E52","#8C3B3F"])
for bb,v,n in zip(bars,vals,ns): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2, v+1.2, f"{v:.1f}%\nn={n}", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("% of variants seen in at least one hemizygous male")
ax.set_title("Truncating DMD variants are strongly depleted in males,\nand the survivors sit at the ends of the transcript", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,70)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
